name: Cashews
siboNotes: Cashews are well-tolerated on SIBO diets at moderate portions. Their lower fiber content compared to other nuts makes them gentler on sensitive digestive systems.
preparationTips: Choose unsalted, unroasted varieties to avoid digestive irritation
Soak raw cashews for 2-4 hours to make them easier to digest
Start with smaller portions (10-15 nuts) if you're newly introducing FODMAPs
Store in airtight containers to maintain freshness and prevent rancidity
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of magnesium for muscle and nerve function
Contains copper for immune system support
Provides zinc for wound healing and immune function
